message.content:
To **log in to a Microsoft account**, go to **account.microsoft.com** and select **Sign in**.[1][2]

- Enter the **email address or phone number** associated with your account, then select **Next**.[2]
- Enter your **password** and select **Sign in**.[2]
- If you do not have an account, choose **Create an account** or **New to Microsoft?**.[2][4]
- If sign-in fails, Microsoft says to use its **sign-in helper tool** or **Contact Support** for account issues.[2]

If you meant **Outlook** or **OneDrive** specifically, those also use the same Microsoft account sign-in flow.[6][7]
